items.name: Rozorpay-clone-Project
items.description: A modern Razorpay Clone built using Tailwind CSS, featuring a fully responsive UI and smooth animations. This project replicates the clean design of Razorpay’s homepage, including sections like Hero, Features, Payment Solutions, Testimonials, CTA, and Footer. Perfect for practicing frontend development, component structuring, and responsive layouts

items.name: huddle-landing-page
items.description: Huddle Landing Page A responsive front-end landing page built with pure HTML and CSS, replicating the Huddle community platform design. Features a hero section, feature cards with alternating layouts, a CTA section with footer overlap effect, and a dark-themed footer — fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile.

items.name: TrendFollowingSystems
items.description: Calculate expected returns and risk metrics for trend-following systems under various price processes with complete Python implementations and historical data.

items.name: Netflix_Clone
items.description: This is a Netflix Clone built using HTML and CSS, designed to replicate the visual aesthetics of Netflix’s homepage. It includes a responsive layout, a hero section with a background image, a call-to-action (CTA) button, and multiple content sections showcasing movies and TV shows. This project is purely front-end, focusing on UI/UX design.

items.name: minetap_aplovin
items.description: Playable Ads for MineTap (Merge / Craft / Idle Clicker RPG): an interactive HTML creative that replicates the core loop of the game – tapping a mining block → obtaining resources → merging identical blocks into rarer ones → crafting an item on a workbench/in a forge → powering up a hero and “winning” a mini-clash, followed by a CTA to install.
